potions.name: Healing Draught

source.file: 4.0 Magic and Spellcasting/4.9.0 Magic Items and Enchanted Treasures.md
source.heading: 4.9.2 Potions

potions.text: A red, bitter draught that knits flesh: 2d6 hit points and 1 System Strain. It brings back the Mortally Wounded.

potions.name: Greater Healing

source.file: 4.0 Magic and Spellcasting/4.9.0 Magic Items and Enchanted Treasures.md
source.heading: 4.9.2 Potions

potions.text: A thick, dark draught brewed twice over: 4d6 hit points and 1 System Strain. It brings back the Mortally Wounded.

potions.name: Restorative Tonic

source.file: 4.0 Magic and Spellcasting/4.9.0 Magic Items and Enchanted Treasures.md
source.heading: 4.9.2 Potions

potions.text: A clear tonic that settles a worn body: 1 System Strain eased, even while Hungry, Sleepless, or Cold. Out of fights only.

potions.name: Waking Tonic

source.file: 4.0 Magic and Spellcasting/4.9.0 Magic Items and Enchanted Treasures.md
source.heading: 4.9.2 Potions

potions.text: A hot, peppery tonic: the drinker is no longer Sleepless or Cold, until the conditions come again. Out of fights only.

potions.name: Oil of Edge

source.file: 4.0 Magic and Spellcasting/4.9.0 Magic Items and Enchanted Treasures.md
source.heading: 4.9.2 Potions

potions.text: A silvery oil rubbed on a blade or point: +1 to hit and damage for the rest of the fight. In fights only.

potions.name: Shadow Draught

source.file: 4.0 Magic and Spellcasting/4.9.0 Magic Items and Enchanted Treasures.md
source.heading: 4.9.2 Potions

potions.text: A grey draught passed round the party: like The Excellent Transpicuous Transformation, it lets the party slip away from a group that spotted it first.

alchemists.name: Mother Vell
alchemists.text: A stooped herbwife who boils roots in the back of a tannery. Her draughts taste of bark and work better than they should.

alchemists.name: Corwin Ashby
alchemists.text: A former army surgeon who brews in copper stills he salvaged from the old imperial depot.

alchemists.name: Brakka Ashtongue
alchemists.text: An orc brewer who learned her trade dosing a legion. She still measures by the war-cup.

alchemists.name: Pilt Fennick
alchemists.text: A goblin who distils things in jars he won't let anyone see into. The temple buys his tonics by the case.
